verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents its own passkey storage and sign-in, and separately lists clients on Windows, macOS and Linux plus Chromium and Firefox browser extensions, with community confirming iOS and Android apps. The evidence never explicitly says passkeys sync across these clients or that the mobile apps act as OS-level passkey providers, so cross-ecosystem sync is implied rather than documented. The mid-2023 comment about missing passkey support predates the passkey docs and is not a concrete contradiction. missing for 10: explicit documentation that passkeys sync across devices and platforms, evidence of passkey use on iOS/Android as a system credential provider, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-platform passkey sync.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor

citations.quote: Passkeys allow you to authenticate yourself for online accounts without using passwords or passphrases.
Next time you access the site, Proton Pass will prompt you to enter using your passkey.
Our desktop app is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
The Chrome browser extension also works on Chromium-based browsers, including Edge, Brave, Chromium, Opera, and Vivaldi.
Proton Pass for Firefox also works with Firefox-based browsers, such as LibreWolf.
